# New Nails & Lashes

> Nail & lash studio based in Pflugerville, Texas. Solar, gel, SNS and acrylic sets, mani-pedis, lash extensions, facials, waxing and brow tinting in a clean, calm studio on S. 12th St in Pflugerville. Walk-ins welcome. Regulars come back for years for the detail, the friendly welcome and the fair prices.

## Services
- Acrylic & solar sets: Full sets and fills with the shape, length and finish you asked for, from short and sweet to long coffin and stiletto.
- Gel, SNS & French tips: Glossy gel manicures, SNS dip and crisp French tips, classic white or with a little twist.
- Nail art: 3D flowers, gold foil, marble, glitter, hearts and rhinestones. Bring a picture or let us get creative.
- Manicures & pedicures: Relax in a clean, calm studio while we take care of your hands and feet.
- Lash extensions: Soft, wispy or full and dramatic: lash extensions that open up your eyes, applied with care in a private room.
- Facials, waxing & brows: Facials, waxing and eyebrow tinting to finish the look, all in the same visit.

## About
New Nails & Lashes is a family-run nail and lash studio in a suite on S. 12th St in Pflugerville. Walk in and you'll find the pink “Hello Gorgeous” flower wall, kid-size pedicure chairs for little clients, and a space clients describe again and again as clean, calm and welcoming: the kind of place where you can actually relax instead of feeling rushed. The techs take their time and get the details right, from crisp French tips and soft natural sets to long acrylics with 3D flowers, gold chrome and rhinestones. Lash extensions are done in a private room, wispy and natural or full and dramatic. Some regulars have been coming for years, and a few drive in from across north Austin and beyond. Little touches matter here too: a friendly hello at the door, a complimentary drink during your service, and prices regulars call very reasonable for the level of work.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Do you take walk-ins?
  A: Yes, walk-ins are welcome. If you want to be sure a chair is open, call (512) 341-0539 before you head over.
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Monday to Friday 10 am to 7 pm, Saturday 9 am to 7 pm, closed Sunday.
- Q: What nail services do you offer?
  A: Acrylic full sets and fills, solar nails, gel manicures, SNS dip, French tips and custom nail art, plus manicures and pedicures.
- Q: Do you do lashes and brows?
  A: Yes. Lash extensions (in a private room), eyebrow tinting and waxing, plus facials.
- Q: Can I bring my kids?
  A: Yes. The studio has two kid-size pedicure chairs, so little ones can get pampered too.
- Q: Can I bring a picture of the design I want?
  A: Please do. 3D flowers, gold foil, marble, hearts, rhinestones: show us the look and we'll make it yours.
- Q: How can I pay?
  A: Credit cards and Apple Pay are accepted. The studio is wheelchair accessible.
- Q: Where are you?
  A: 100 S. 12th St, Suite 108A, Pflugerville, TX 78660. Call (512) 341-0539 or (512) 922-3732.
